name: Compliance Audit and Due-Diligence Review (Data Stays Home, Logic Stays Yours)
description: For investment due diligence, supplier audits, internal-control and data-compliance checks: the reviewer seals its checking logic into a package for the auditee, the auditee runs it against its local database and returns only a summary of findings. Data never leaves the auditee; the checking logic is never readable by the auditee — protection in both directions. Built on MGC Blackbox 1.6.0, supports p2p single-node licensing and free-mode standard check packages, and ships with a runnable minimal example.
author: MirginCipher Team
